2126301159702888576.en_summary: Describes a massive interstellar rebound after a schizophrenic week. Key events: US proposes 20-35% tariffs on 14 partners and core PCE at 3.3% vs 3.2% expected, Nasdaq briefly hits -20% bear market with VIX near 35, then rebounds to flat on FCC orbital data centers approval and short covering before Thanksgiving. Asia AI chain rallies hard (Seoul +5%, SK Hynix +5.41%, Shanghai +4.2%, STAR 50 +15%). NVDA hit by reports of Chinese firms installing Blackwell chips (GB300 NVL72) in Shanghai via Megaspeed despite export bans, plus S&P AA watch and server shipment pauses, likely first major revenue revision. Memory market becomes seller's with Kioxia allocating 2027 capacity, $MU down ~15% in two sessions as TrendForce/Goldman see 2028 price drops. Texas data center permits resume including SpaceX project. November Nasdaq 100 down 8% until Wednesday, VIX to 40.
2126301159702888576.zh_summary: 描述經歷精神分裂症式一周後的巨大星際反彈。主要事件：美國對 14 個夥伴提議 20-35% 關稅，核心 PCE 為 3.3% 高於預期 3.2%，納斯達克短暫進入 -20% 熊市，VIX 接近 35，隨後因 FCC 批准軌道數據中心及感恩節前空頭回補而回升至平盤。亞洲 AI 鏈強力反彈（首爾 +5%，SK Hynix +5.41%，上海 +4.2%，STAR 50 +15%）。NVDA 因報導中國公司透過 Megaspeed 在上海安裝 Blackwell 晶片（GB300 NVL72）違反出口禁令而受挫，加上 S&P AA 負面觀察及伺服器出貨暫停，可能迎來首次重大營收下修。記憶體市場轉為賣方市場，Kioxia 已分配 2027 年產能，$MU 兩日跌約 15%，TrendForce/Goldman 預見 2028 年價格下跌。德克薩斯州重啟數據中心許可，包括 SpaceX 項目。十一月納斯達克 100 至周三下跌 8%，VIX 升至 40。

ticker_notes.NVDA: 中國公司安裝 Blackwell 晶片引關注，可能營收下修
ticker_notes.MU: 記憶體價格預期下跌，股價兩日跌約 15%

2126297486805684667.en_summary: At this point, we can pretty much say that the month is going to close negative for the S&P 500. Since 1950, there have been only 8 cases where both October and November were negative. In all cases, December was positive. $SPX
2126297486805684667.zh_summary: 到這個時候，我們基本上可以說這個月標普 500 將收負。自 1950 年以來，只有 8 次十月和十一月都為負。在所有情況下，十二月都是正的。$SPX

ticker_notes.SPY: 十月十一月雙負後十二月歷史上皆為正

2126295982438596805.en_summary: Hopes we've seen the lows given bad sentiment and Wednesday capitulation/depression. $QQQ from ATH to -20% in less than 6.5 weeks, 3rd fastest crash ever behind dotcom and covid. RSI on $QQQ to 26.5, only lower in past 4+ years was April 2025 low (March 2020 was 26.9). After April 2025 low $QQQ up +37% in 3 months and +50% in 6 months. Similar for $SMH with double bottom, filled April 2026 gap, up +64% in 3 months and +94% in 6 months after April 2025 low.
2126295982438596805.zh_summary: 希望已經見到低點，考慮到本周進入時的惡劣情緒以及周三的投降與沮喪。$QQQ 從歷史高點到 -20% 不到 6.5 周，是有史以來第三快的崩跌，僅次於互聯網泡沫與新冠崩跌。$QQQ 的 RSI 降至 26.5，過去 4 年多來唯一更低是 2025 年 4 月低點（2020 年 3 月為 26.9）。2025 年 4 月低點後 $QQQ 3 個月上漲 +37%、6 個月上漲 +50%。$SMH 類似，有雙底並填補 2026 年 4 月缺口，2025 年 4 月低點後 3 個月上漲 +64%、6 個月上漲 +94%。

ticker_notes.QQQ: RSI 接近歷史低點，歷史上類似低點後強勢反彈
ticker_notes.SMH: 類似技術形態，歷史反彈更強

2126293253230137620.en_summary: $WMT $COST $AMZN - BLACK FRIDAY SPENDING SET TO RISE DESPITE CONSUMER FINANCIAL PRESSURE. U.S. holiday spending expected to increase 5.4% in 2026 per PwC, inflation-adjusted 2.8%. Adobe Analytics forecasts nearly $13 billion in online Black Friday sales. Consumers cautious: 80%+ manage costs with cheaper gifts or fewer people, 40% seek resale, average budget $779 down from $796 in 2025. Stronger retail revenues don't necessarily mean stronger purchasing power.
2126293253230137620.zh_summary: $WMT $COST $AMZN - 儘管消費者財務壓力，黑色星期五支出預計上升。根據 PwC，2026 年美國假日支出預計增加 5.4%，經通脹調整後為 2.8%。Adobe Analytics 預測線上黑色星期五銷售近 130 億美元。消費者更加謹慎：80% 以上透過選擇更便宜禮物或減少購買人數管理成本，40% 尋找轉售，平均假日預算 779 美元，低於 2025 年的 796 美元。更強的零售營收不一定意味著更強的購買力。
